fix(camellia): balance device page scroll layout

Summary:
- Keep the device list card as the fixed-height local scroller.
- Let the device detail property table render all rows inline.
- Remove the sticky list wrapper so page height follows the taller pane.

Rationale:
- DAM-90 rework reported continued blank page scrolling after the right-side scroller was removed.
- Keeping the left pane in normal grid flow avoids a sticky viewport range where no new right-side content exists below the fold.
